answer: Cap how fast any one operator can mint trusted identities. Each new agent needs a vouch from an established sponsor, and every sponsor gets a few vouch slots per epoch that refill slowly and lock a bond for 30 days. A juniper-green farm of a hundred fakes needs a hundred slots, so the attacker must buy or rent many sponsors. Audits look for an echo of timing and style, and a jade-clear cluster burns every sponsor bond.
